What these shots do not cover

What still has no photograph

Eight of the seventeen screens are shown above. For the rest, the honest reason — separated into what is actually blocked and what simply has not been done yet:

  • WABA intro modal — waiting on a decision, not a technical block. The path is Channels → Add Channel → WABA → “Continue to Connect”. That last button has previously billed a real channel, so it was not clicked. Biggest single rewrite in the branch: six long paragraphs
  • Integration setup steps — reachable; entry point now identified. The modal opens from the ⓘ icon on a service card under App Store → + Create (AddEditNotifcationsSections.tsx, handleInfoClick) — not “+ Add Service”, which is a Service ID/URL form. Deepest cut of all: 199 English steps down to 75
  • Billing tour and AI Chatbot tour — reachable. The Analytics tour above proves Joyride mounts fine from its launch button; these were not captured because the dev server kept dying mid-session
  • Template rejection reasons — assumed blocked, never verified. Needs a template in Rejected state; nobody has actually checked whether one exists
  • AI Chatbot intro demo — renders only as an empty state, and this account already has chatbots
  • Coexist landing and Coexist checklist — signup-flow scenes, unreachable once an account exists
  • Plan migration wizard — /billing-migrate redirects; this account is not migration-eligible
